200.body: “Belarusian White-Red-White And White-Red Flags Bow In Tribute” — Polish President Posthumously Honors Aliaksandr Milinkevich Main Фото: t.me/tsikhanouskaya Author reform.news Published by 16:26 22.08.2026 Polish President Karol Nawrocki has posthumously awarded Aliaksandr Milinkevich the Officer’s Cross of the Order of Merit of the Republic of Poland. In it, the Polish president described Milinkevich as a scholar, educator, public figure and politician who devoted himself to the cause of a free Belarus. “Belarusian white-red-white, as well as white-and-red, flags bow today in tribute to a man of immense knowledge, integrity and courage. 300.title: Poland tightens access to its labor market for citizens of Georgia, Colombia and Venezuela
300.summary: Poland tightens access to its labor market for citizens of Georgia, Colombia and Venezuela Authorities say visa-free system was being used for employment without fulfilling migration requirements By Jo Harper WARSAW (AA) — Poland on Saturday tightened access to its labor market for citizens of Georgia, Colombia and Venezuela, barring them from working on the basis of a work permit while staying in the country visa-free.
300.body: Poland tightens access to its labor market for citizens of Georgia, Colombia and Venezuela Authorities say visa-free system was being used for employment without fulfilling migration requirements By Jo Harper WARSAW (AA) — Poland on Saturday tightened access to its labor market for citizens of Georgia, Colombia and Venezuela, barring them from working on the basis of a work permit while staying in the country visa-free. Under regulations that took effect on August 22, nationals of the three countries who want to work in Poland must hold an appropriate visa or another form of legal residence that allows employment, rather than relying on visa-free entry. The measure does not end visa-free travel for tourism and other permitted short-term visits but separates the right to enter Poland without a visa from the right to take up employment.

400.body: Siemens , Energys Siemens Energy's €1 Billion Buyback Closes Just as Europe's Grid Supercycle Takes Shape Published on 08/22/2026 at 22:21 | Redaktion boerse-global.de Siemens Energy finishes €1B share repurchase as EU grid spending hits €1.2T, with record orders and strategic carve-out speculation looming. Siemens Energy has just wrapped up its first-ever share repurchase program, spending roughly €1 billion to buy back 6.47 million of its own shares — and it did so against a backdrop that has little to do with the daily noise of the trading floor and everything to do with the next 15 years of European infrastructure spending. The third-quarter figures bear this out: order intake of €17.9 billion — a record, by the company's own account — alongside revenue of €11.4 billion and adjusted earnings of €1.62 billion. 600.body: Ajayi, Ezekiel make competitive returns in Poland August 23, 2026 12:11 am Nigerian sprinter Kanyinsola Ajayi By Peter Akinbo Kindly share this story: Nigerian sprinters, Kanyinsola Ajayi and Ezekiel Nathaniel, are set to make their first competitive returns since the Commonwealth Games when they line up at the Silesia Diamond League meeting in Poland on Sunday (today).
